name: ShadcnStore
summary: Marketplace of 269 shadcn/ui blocks across 39 sections, with premium Next.js templates and a Figma kit installable via the shadcn CLI.
description: Production-ready shadcn/ui blocks, components and premium templates for React apps. Blocks cover marketing (navbar, hero, features, testimonials, FAQ, pricing, team, footer, CTA, stats, logo cloud, bento grid, contact, banners), e-commerce (storefront hero, product lists, carts, checkout, reviews, order history, filters) and application (app shells, charts, datatables, widgets, auth forms, calendars, error pages). Install with the shadcn CLI from the ShadcnStore registry; every section has at least one free block, and pro unlocks the rest plus the Figma kit.
contains: 269 shadcn/ui blocks across 39 sections; 55 free and 214 premium
